edges.reason: msg.sender from the Owned constructor is written into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner gates privileged functions on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setName is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSymbol is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
kill is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner, changing ownership state.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
The owner state variable is the beneficiary of selfdestruct.
owner is the fixed recipient of the rescue ERC20 transfer.
kill executes the selfdestruct unsafe operation.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller-controlled identity.
approve keys the allowed mapping with msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], keyed by the caller.
approveAndCall keys allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender externally.
msg.sender is passed into the external receiveApproval call, exposing caller identity to a callback.
approveAndCall executes the external receiveApproval call after updating allowance state.
The external callee can call back into approveAndCall / approve / transferFrom before the call returns.
transferAnyERC20Token performs the external ERC20 transfer call.
The arbitrary tokenAddress contract can re-enter the rescue function during the external call.
spender supplied by the caller becomes the target of the external call.
tokens value is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary data bytes are forwarded to the external callee.
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens amount is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
tokens is the subtrahend in safeSub for the sender balance.
tokens is added to the recipient balance via safeAdd.
transferFrom tokens is subtracted from balances[from] and from the allowance.
transferFrom tokens is added to balances[to] via safeAdd.
approve writes tokens into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes tokens into the allowed mapping.
spender is the second key of the allowed nested mapping in approve.
recipient address indexes the balances mapping in transfer.
from address indexes the balances mapping in transferFrom.
to address indexes the balances mapping in transferFrom.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned coins.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
The constructor mints the whole _totalSupply supply.
The constructor credits balances of the fixed distribution address.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
tokenOwner is the lookup key for balanceOf.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
tokenOwner is the first key of the allowance lookup.
spender is the second key of the allowance lookup.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
setSymbol overwrites the symbol state variable.
setName overwrites the name state variable.
The _value parameter is written into symbol.
The _value parameter is written into name.
safeSub relies on assert-based arithmetic checking that reverts with all gas.
safeAdd relies on assert-based overflow checking.
safeMul relies on assert(c / a == b) overflow checking.
safeDiv performs unchecked division (division by zero reverts).
First operand a feeds the multiplication in safeMul.
Second operand b feeds the multiplication in safeMul.
Minuend a feeds the subtraction in safeSub.
Subtrahend b is asserted to be <= a in safeSub.
First addend a feeds the addition in safeAdd.
Second addend b feeds the addition in safeAdd.
Dividend a feeds the division in safeDiv.
Divisor b feeds the division in safeDiv.
Local product c is the return value of safeMul.
Local quotient c is the return value of safeDiv.

transferFrom.to is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom.
transferFrom.tokens is a parameter consumed only by transferFrom.
allowance.tokenOwner is a lookup key used only by allowance.
allowance.spender is a lookup key used only by allowance.

approveAndCall.tokens is consumed only by approveAndCall.

setSymbol._value is consumed only by setSymbol.
transferOwnership._newOwner is consumed only by transferOwnership.
